fields.Name: Open
fields.Description: The deal is live and progressing. The only status a new deal starts in.

fields.Name: Won
fields.Description: The customer committed. This is the status whose transition creates a contract and/or orders in one transaction — and it LOCKS the deal, because the deal is now the provenance of both.

fields.Name: Lost
fields.Description: The customer chose otherwise. Requires a LossReason; locks the deal so the reason cannot be quietly revised later.

fields.Name: Abandoned
fields.Description: We walked away, or the deal went dark. Counts as lost for win-rate and forecast purposes — the distinction from Lost is diagnostic, not behavioural, which is exactly why it is a separate ROW rather than a separate code path.

fields.Name: On Hold
fields.Description: Paused — neither progressing nor concluded, which is why it is neither IsOpen nor IsClosed. That combination is the reason those two flags are not each other's inverse: a rollup asking 'still live' and one asking 'not yet concluded' want different answers here.
